parsed.faithful: _Amicable Benches,_ in Roman antiquity, were, according to Pitiscus, lower and less honourable feats allotted for the _judices pedanei_, or inferior judges, who, upon being admitted of the emperor's council, were dignified by him with the title _amici_.
